subject: EMEA coverage request + proposed comp bands and hire sequencing
messages: Subject: EMEA coverage request + proposed comp bands and hire sequencing

Following our Q2–Q3 planning review I pulled together a compact headcount request for EMEA coverage tied to three upcoming RFPs (incl. BrightEdge), forecasted ARR, and quota relief needs. High-level ask: add 6 net new GTM roles to start in Q4 FY27 (target start range Oct–Dec):
- 2 Solutions Engineers (regional SEs) — embedded with AE pods
- 1 Senior Customer Success Manager — renewals + expansion lead

Rationale: expected deal pipeline acceleration (see attached headcount_plan_q4_emea.xlsx) — three strategic deals would require full AE+SE coverage to avoid time-to-value and reduce churn risk on pilot deployments. The attached comp_bands_emea_v2.pdf contains proposed bands by role and market. Summary below (total OTE ranges):
AE: 80k–140k EUR OTE depending on market/experience

Estimated first-year fully-loaded cost (hiring + ramp): ~€1.1M (headcount + recruiting + equipment). I included a conservative ramp profile that assumes 6 months to 70% quota attainment for AEs and 4 months for SEs. The recruitment timeline we should plan for is 8–10 weeks per role; contracting in-region (Germany/UK) will add ~3 weeks for paperwork. I also sketched a prioritized sequencing: 2 AEs + 1 SE (Phase 1), 1 AE + 1 SE (Phase 2), then CSM (Phase 3) — to align with expected deal milestones.
- Can you review/approve the six hires in principle so I can start reqs and sourcing (I can split by country once you confirm budget sign-off)?
- Confirm whether we should route recruiting budget through EMEA cost center 4021 or central GTM (Finance needs a cost center to approve),
- Any objections to the proposed AE comp bands for UK/DE vs. the row markets in the PDF?

I attached the headcount plan and comp bands and flagged a couple of high-priority accounts (incl. BrightEdge) where coverage gaps create execution risk. If you want, I can push this to a short sync (15 min) tomorrow morning.

Thanks Jonas — good write-up. A few clarifying asks before I take this to Finance: 

1) Can you break the 6 hires down by country and FTE type (UK: x, DE: y, remote EMEA: z)? Germany hiring has additional payroll steps — call that out in the doc.
2) Which of these are priority #1 if we only get approval for 3 hires this quarter? Put recommended sequencing in the sheet.
3) For the AE bands, show expected OTE distribution and on-target quota and territory size — I want to avoid over-indexing bands where quota coverage is small.

Also add expected start dates per phase and the recruiting owner (internal recruiter vs. agency). Please update the Drive folder and ping me when ready.

Laura
VP, Sales Operations

---
Subject: Re: EMEA coverage request + proposed comp bands and hire sequencing
Jonas / Laura — adding SE perspective. Good structure; two quick notes from hiring/comp side for SEs:

- Interview loop: recruiter screen -> technical take-home (30–45 min) -> panel (AE + SE manager + hiring manager) -> onsite/virtual final. I recommend including a short customer-facing exercise tailored to BrightEdge-style pilots.
- SE comp adjustments: given market pressure in UK/DE, bump top of band by ~7% vs the PDF for senior SE candidates. Germany is especially competitive for cloud infra talent right now — recommend offering local benefits allowance to bridge gaps.
- Bench plan: propose we create one pooled contract bench (6–8 week contractor) for immediate coverage for pilots while full-time hires ramp — this reduces time-to-value for the BrightEdge pilot.

I've sketched these into se_comp_band_notes.md in the Drive folder and flagged two candidate sourcing partners that have proven success in Nordics/DE.

Hannah
Head of Solutions Engineering, EMEA
